title: Fix Natural Aim Assist 26.2
objective: Make Natural Aim Assist visibly functional in real gameplay, expand FOV to 360 degrees, and replace coarse cycle buttons with precise sliders/editable numeric controls.
acceptance_criteria: Rebalance correction so valid targets receive clearly observable assistance while preserving manual pull-away.
Strength, FOV, and range use precise slider controls with editable numeric values.
Existing boolean targeting/combat settings remain functional and persist.
Version is bumped and Java 25 / Minecraft 26.2 CI build, simulations, smoke launch, and final JAR verification pass.
